name: Demon Hunter: Cursed Hearts
source:
When you're recruited by demon hunters, you're suddenly thrust into a world you never knew existed!

After witnessing the death of your father, you learn that you come from a long line of demon hunters. What's more, your mother's locket was once the property of a powerful demon hunter, and contains one half of an ancient, powerful demon known only as the Founder.

When the locket becomes damaged, only you can prevent the Founder from escaping and unleashing his terrible vengeance on the world.

Can you rally three mismatched demon hunters from the Tokyo Demon Hunter Academy and eradicate the Founder once and for all?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.demoncurse]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
当你被恶魔猎手招募时，你突然被带入了一个你从未知道存在的世界！

在目睹了你父亲的死亡后，你得知自己来自恶魔猎手的世系。更重要的是，你母亲的挂坠盒曾经是一位强大的恶魔猎手的财产，里面有一个古老而强大的恶魔的一半，人们只知道它的创始人。

当挂坠盒损坏时，只有你才能阻止创始人逃跑并对世界发动可怕的复仇。

你能从东京猎魔者学院召集三名不匹配的恶魔猎手并一劳永逸地消灭创始人吗？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.demoncurse]Google Play[/url]]
